The paper considers an extended weighted generalized fractional optimal control problem without constraints on the control functions.
The dynamics of the optimal control problem are described by a weighted generalized fractional differential equation of order 0 ≤ α < 1 and parameter β > 0.
The paper proves a weak version of a weighted generalized fractional Pontryagin's maximum principle as the main result.
As corollaries, the paper obtains necessary optimality conditions for Caputo-Fabrizio, Atangana-Baleanu, and weighted Atangana-Baleanu fractional optimal control problems.
The paper derives a new weighted generalized fractional Euler-Lagrange equation for a fractional calculus of variations problem.
The paper utilizes recent results on weighted generalized fractional derivatives and integrals, as well as a weighted generalized fractional integration by parts formula.
The paper mentions potential future research directions, such as extending the results to vector-valued problems and developing numerical schemes.
The fractional order parameter α is considered in the range 0 ≤ α < 1.
The functions L and f are assumed to be differentiable with respect to all their arguments, and the control set U is assumed to be a nonempty open subset of R.
The weighted generalized fractional integration by parts formula is a key mathematical tool used in the derivation of the necessary optimality conditions.
The paper introduces an augmented functional to derive the necessary optimality conditions using a variational approach.
The paper aims to contribute to the theoretical development of a generalized fractional theory of optimal control.
The paper's results can be applied to various fractional optimal control and fractional calculus of variations problems.
The paper builds upon recent advancements in the theory of weighted generalized fractional operators and integration by parts.
The necessary optimality conditions obtained in the paper are in the form of a Hamiltonian system and a stationary condition.
